title: Halcyon: the startup network
brief: Halcyon Corp started small. Protect the database from everything that comes in from the internet. Tap a node to build a defense, then start the wave.
debrief: Each defense only counters certain attacks. Matching them is the whole game: this is defense in depth.
hint.1: Floods (DDoS) are stopped by a firewall. Phishing ignores firewalls: it needs an email filter.
hint.2: Password guessing is stopped by MFA. Worms need a patched machine.
hint.3: Place the defense on a node the attack passes through, not only on the target.
walkthrough: Wave 1 firewall on the router, wave 2 email filter on the mail server, wave 3 MFA on the router, wave 4 patch the laptop.
